title: QESChunker: A Single Objective Unifies Overlapping and Non-Overlapping Chunking for RAG
abstract: arXiv:2610.36557v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Chunking is a fundamental preprocessing step in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), yet most existing chunkers rely primarily on heuristics. We introduce the Question--Evidence-Supervised Chunker (QESChunker), to our knowledge the first method for constructing static chunk indices from question--evidence supervision. QESChunker constructs document-specific chunk indices by optimizing over human-annotated or LLM-generated question--evidence pairs, without access to held-out test queries. We formulate non-overlapping and overlapping index construction through a unified question--evidence utility-maximization objective, turning chunking into a supervised combinatorial optimization problem. Under the non-overlap constraint, the objective decomposes over chunks and can be optimized exactly in polynomial time by dynamic programming. translated_abstract: 分块是检索增强生成（RAG）中的一个基础预处理步骤，然而现有的大多数分块器主要依赖启发式方法。我们提出了问题-证据监督分块器（QESChunker），据我们所知，这是首个从问题-证据监督中构建静态分块索引的方法。QESChunker通过在人工标注或大语言模型生成的问题-证据对上进行优化来构建文档特定的分块索引，且无需访问留出的测试查询。我们通过一个统一的问题-证据效用最大化目标来表述非重叠和重叠索引构建，从而将分块转化为一个有监督的组合优化问题。在非重叠约束下，该目标可以在各个分块上进行分解，并可通过动态规划在多项式时间内精确优化。当允许重叠时，该目标变为单调次模的；其精确优化是NP难的，但我们的g…（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出QESChunker，以统一的问题-证据效用最大化目标将RAG中的非重叠与重叠分块统一为有监督组合优化问题，非重叠情形可通过动态规划在多项式时间内精确求解。
en_tdlr: QESChunker unifies overlapping and non-overlapping chunking for RAG as a supervised combinatorial optimization problem with a single question-evidence utility-maximization objective, which is exactly solvable in polynomial time via dynamic programming under the non-overlap constraint.
